effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 [Airu Suzaki], [Ren Tobari] or [Ryoma Mogami] from your hand without paying its cost.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞. Then, place 1 Digimon card with ＜Save＞ in its text from your trash under 1 of your Tamers.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has ＜Save＞ in its text, it gets +2000 DP.
